---
title: "Privacy Policy"
---

**Project:** Audience Discourse on Bangladeshi Artists Research Client\
**Operator:** Tahia Anan Dhira, independent researcher\
**Last updated:** 28 September 2026

This is a non-commercial, non-funded, independent academic research project.
It uses the YouTube Data API v3 to retrieve publicly available comments from a
defined set of Bangladeshi artist and entertainment channels, for aggregate
analysis of audience discourse.

**What is accessed.** Only public data returned by the API, such as comment
text, comment dates, and video and channel identifiers. The project does not
access private accounts, does not ask YouTube users to sign in or authorize
anything, and does not offer a service to the public.

**How it is used.** The data is analyzed for aggregate patterns, such as
sentiment and topic statistics. Only aggregate findings are reported.

**What is shared.** Raw comments and commenter identifiers are not published,
sold, or redistributed.

**Storage.** API data is stored on the researcher's own devices and handled in
line with the YouTube API Services Developer Policies.

**Removal requests.** If you wrote a comment and want it excluded from this
research, contact the email below.

Use of YouTube API Services is subject to the
[YouTube Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms). Google's data
practices are described in the
[Google Privacy Policy](http://www.google.com/policies/privacy).
